subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Small rural hospitals with 25 inpatient beds at most, paid by Medicare on their costs.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Tucson Medical Center have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: No other TMC Healthcare hospital reports more; Benson Hospital is next at 175. About 7.5 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Benson Hospital have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 TMC Healthcare hospitals; Tucson Medical Center has the most, 3,777. About 8.0 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did Northern Cochise Community Hospital have on its payroll in 2024?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 TMC Healthcare hospitals; Tucson Medical Center has the most, 3,777. About 5.3 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians trained at Tucson Medical Center in 2024?
questions.why: Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees do TMC Healthcare's hospitals have on payroll, added together?
questions.why: From all 3 hospitals' latest cost reports, mostly 2024.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent resident physicians train in TMC Healthcare's hospitals, added together?
questions.why: One of its hospitals reports residents; Tucson Medical Center trains the most, 46.

questions.q: What percent of Tucson Medical Center's inpatient days in 2024 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other TMC Healthcare hospital runs higher; Northern Cochise Community Hospital is next at 40 percent. Traditional Medicare was 20 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 31 percent.

questions.why: That is the lowest of 3 TMC Healthcare hospitals; Tucson Medical Center runs highest, 51 percent. Traditional Medicare was 34 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 4 percent.

questions.q: How many hospitals does TMC Healthcare run, by the federal list of health systems?
questions.why: All of them are in Arizona. A system's own count can differ: it may count campuses on their own, or hospitals that joined after 2023.
